title: SII Vol. 14 No. 226 — Vijayanarayanam
location_detail: On the south wall of the Rajagopalasvamin temple

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 227 — Sivapuri
location_detail: On the north wall of the second prakara in the Svayamprakasa temple
summary: Dated in the 10th year of the king, this record of Sirvallabha without any distinguishing attributes, registers the gift of land in a plot called Tokkalivayal by a certain lady Panjan Uyyavandal of Aruviyur for a lamp to be burnt in the temple of Tiruttandonrisvaram-Udaiyar

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 228 — Tiruppattur
location_detail: On the north wall of the mandapa in the Tiruttalisvara temple
summary: This epigraph dated in the tenth year and 205th day of the king registers remission of taxes amounting to 43 2/20 madai on two hamlets for providing worship to the god Tiruttali-Mahadeva at Tiruppattur a brahmadeya in Keralasinga-valanadu

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 229 — Kuruvitturai
location_detail: On the north wall of the Chitrarathavallabha-Perumal temple
summary: This order was issued when the king was seated in the sat Pandiyarajan in the Alagiyapandiayan hall in the palace at Solantaka-chaturvedimangalam in Paganurkurram and the 11th year quoted in the sixth line of the record was the year in which it was issued

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 230 — Attur
location_detail: On a pillar in the antara of the Somanatha temple
summary: Dated in the 1 th year of Jatavarman Srivallabha this record registers a gift of sheep and a lamp-stand by a brahmana lady named Andamaichchani, the wife of a certain Sarangapani-Tirunilakanthan of Rajaraja-chaturvedimangalam, a brahmadeya in Mulli-nadu, a subdivision of Pandi-nadu

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 231 — Vijayanarayanam

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 232 — Sendamangalam
location_detail: On the west wall of the central shrine in the Kailasanatha temple
summary: This record is dated in the 12th year of Jatavarman Srivallabhadeva, and registers sale of land by the assembly of some village, whose name is lost to the temple of god Kailasamudaiya-Nayanar at Sendamangalam in Arrur, a brahmadeya in Kudanadu

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 233 — Tirukkoshtiyur
location_detail: On a pillar in the mandapa in the nachchiyar shrine in the Saumyanarayana temple

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 234 — Tirukkoshitiyur
location_detail: On the east wall of the storeroom of the Saumyanarayana temple
summary: This record is dated in the 13th year of Jatavarman Srivallabha and was issued from the throne called Kalingattaraiyan in the Alagiyapandiyan-kudam

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 235 — Sivapuri
location_detail: On the north wall of the second prakara in the Svayam rakasa temple
summary: This inscription dated in the 15th year of the reign of Srivallabha registers a gift of land made by Arasu Madalaikkuttan alias Sivakarunalayan, a merchant of the Manigramam guild of Kodumbalur for providing pittu offering to the god Tiruttandoorisvaram-udaiyar

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 236 — Kuruvitiurai
location_detail: On the west wall of the Chitraratha-vallabha-Perumal temple
date_text: This record of Srivallabha is dated in the 16th year and the 171st day

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 229
location_detail: On the representation of Kalingarajan, the exchange in respect of one plat of land recorded in
date_text: of the 11th year of the king registering donations made by Mangadu-kilan, which are referred to here
summary: These lands which had been taken up for cultivation by a certain Sarvakratukkal had to be irrigated by a new channel but as the sabhaiyar of Solantaka-chaturvedimangalam objected to the digging of a new channel, the lands could not be cultivated

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 237 — Attur
location_detail: On a pillar in the south verandah of the fist prakara in the somanatha temple
date_text: This record of Jatavarman Srivallabha, which commences with the usual historical introduction, is dated in the 16th year of the king
summary: It is much damaged; but from the legible portions it appears to register some gift of land to a certain Soman who is described as a Santikkuttan or one who enacted Santikkuttus, a variety of dance and stage-play

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 238 — Tiruppattur
location_detail: On the south wall of the mandapa in the Tiruttalisvara temple
date_text: This record is dated in the 17th year of the king
summary: It registers a gift of money left with the mulaparishad of the village by a merchant of Aruviyur alias Desi-uyyavandapattanam named Vdugan Uyyavandan of Tanjavur, for a flower garden for the supply of karumugai flowers to the temple of Tiruttaliyanda-Nayanar at Tirupputtur

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 239 — Tiruvalisvaram
location_detail: On the south wall of the central shrine in the Tiruvalisvara temple
summary: This damaged record of the king is dated in his 17th year and registers the exemption on taxes granted on the devadana village named Sivacharanasekharanallur belonging to the temple of Tiruvalisvaram-Udaiyar at Rajaraja-chaturvedimangalam, a brahmadeya in Mulli-nadu

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 240 — Ten Tiruppuvanam
location_detail: On the south wall of the Pushpavanesvara temple
summary: This record dated in the 17th year of the king registers a gift of sheep by Kilavan Appan alias Srivallabha-Pandyakkon of Korkai in Kuda-nadu for burning two lamps in the temple of Ten-Tiruppuvanamudaiya-Mahadeva in Mulli-nadu, a sub-division of Pandi-nadu

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 241 — Vijayanarayanam
location_detail: On the south wall of the central shrine in the Adinathaperumal Temple
summary: At the time of issuing this record dated in the 17th year and relating to the temple of Varaguna-vinnagar-Alvar at Vijayanarayana-chaturvedimangalam, the king was staying at his camp in that place

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 242 — Sivapuri
location_detail: On the south wall of the second prakara in the Svayamprakasa temple
summary: This inscription dated in the 18th year of the king relates to the gift of one ma of land in Aruviyur as measured by kuditangi by Arumunaigandar which was purchased from the officials of Devar Duvarapativelar, for the expenses of the temple of god Pillaiyar Desinayaka at Aruviyur alias Desi-Uyyavana

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 243 — Sivapuri
location_detail: On the south Wall of the second prakara in the Svayamprakasa temple
summary: This record of the 18th year relates to the founding of an agaram called Seyyamangalam with the new name of Ambalattadi-chaturvedimangalam, by Kanda-Sundan alias Duvarapativelan, for the merit of Sundan-Kandan alias Duvarapativelan, who was presumably his father

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 244 — Sermadevi
location_detail: On the west wall of the first prakara in the Bhaktavatsala temple
date_text: This record of the 19 + 1st year has to be attributed to Jatavarman Srivallabha though there are no specific indications of this identity
summary: It registers gifts of money by a certain Atkondavilli, Attiyuralvan and Uyyakkondan of Attiyur for burning lamps in the temple of Sribhaktapriyattu-ninraruliya-Paramasvamin at Seravanmadevi-chaturvedimangalam a brahmadeya in Mulli-nadu

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 245 — Ambasamudram
location_detail: On the north wall of the Erichchavadaiyar shrine
summary: This inscription is dated in the 20th year of Jatavarman Srivallabha and registers a gift of land for the expenses of the temple of god Tiruppottudaiya-mahadevar at Rajaraja-chaturvedimangalam a brahmadeya in Mulli-nadu

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 246 — Tiruppattur
location_detail: On the north wall of the mandapa in the Tiruttalisvara temple
summary: This record of the 20th year of Tribhuvanachakravartin Srivallabhadeva registers a gift of 25 cows and a bull by a vellala of Kurralur in Keralasinga-valanadu, for a lamp in the temple of Sritali-Paramesvara at Tirupputtur

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 247 — Tiruppattur
location_detail: On the north wall of the mandapa in the Tiruttalisvara temple
summary: This record, which is also dated in the 20th year of the king, registers the gift of 25 cows and a bull by the wife of Mahamatra Periyalvan of Budanur in Marugal-nadu, a subdivision of Geyamanikka-valanadu, a district of Sola-manadalam

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 248 — Tiruppattur
location_detail: On the north wall of the kitchen in the Tiruttalisvara temple
summary: This record is also dated in the 20th year of the same king and states that the kitchen (irumalaippalli) in the temple of Tiruttaliyandar at Tiruppattur, a brahamadeya in Keralasinga-valanadu was constructed by Ulagamulududaiyar, who is called the queen (mudikkil-nambirattiyar)

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 249 — Sivapuri
location_detail: On the south wall of the second prakara in the Svayamprakasa temple
summary: This record states that Velan Uyyaniraduvan of Pandangudi in Sura-nadu made a gift of a field called Anjadagadan for the kitchen expenses in the temple of Tiruttandonir-Isvaramudaiyar at Nripasekhara-chaturvedimangalam in the 20th year of the reign of Srivallabhadeva

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 250 — Kattarimangalam
location_detail: On the south wall of the Vira-Pandyesvara temple
summary: This record which begins with the usual historical introduction is dated in the 19th year and 500th day of Jatavarman Srivallabha, and was issued while he was seated on the throne called Kalingattaraiyan in his palace at Madurai in the Subdivision Madakkulakkil
